status: PREDECLARED before any run, 2026-10-08, author w2:pC; per w2:p6 lot S-L5. SMOKE_ONLY_NO_CLAIM: plumbing and CPU cost on synthetic pages, no OCR or performance claim.

split.note: eval pages are used for smoke only; the sealed volet 2 is not opened. No sealed manifest listing these ids was found in the docs consulted on 2026-10-08.

scale.height_definition: median over the page's lines of normal_negative_px + normal_positive_px
scale.resampling: PIL bilinear on the image; baselines and distances multiplied by the same factor; nothing written to disk

tiles.train: one random tile per step; lines kept only if their whole band lies inside the tile
tiles.eval: central tile of each eval page

ctc_lines_selection: readable lines only, drawn at random among lines fully inside the tile

input_perturbation.description: GT baseline shifted rigidly along the chord normal by d ~ N(0, (0.5 h)^2), h = GT band height

losses.L_det: BCE on baseline map (stride 4) with pos_weight = min(50, #neg/#pos), plus L1 on neg and pos over baseline-mask cells
losses.L_geo: curve_geometry_loss between refined baseline and GT baseline (K=8 points), normalised by GT height, mean over lines
losses.L_ctc: sum of included expected CTC losses divided by the number of included lines; exclusions counted by status

evaluation.after: refine_lines applied to the extracted polylines
evaluation.cer: greedy CTC decode of the matched readable GT lines, after refinement only; levenshtein / len(gt text)

time_limit_policy: a run over the limit is stopped and reported; nothing is reduced after the fact

expectations_written_before_run.note: no expected metric values are declared; the smoke run is for plumbing and seconds per step
